Attention Is All You Need

1 Introduction

Recurrent models typically factor computation along the symbol positions of the input and output sequences.

Attention mechanisms have become an integral part of compelling sequence modeling and transduction models in various tasks.

2 Background

The goal of reducing sequential computation also forms the foundation of the Extended Neural GPU, ByteNet and ConvS2S.

3 Model Architecture

Most competitive neural sequence transduction models have an encoder-decoder structure. Here, the encoder maps an input sequence of symbol representations to a sequence of continuous representations.

The Transformer follows this overall architecture using stacked self-attention and point-wise, fully connected layers for both the encoder and decoder.

Appendix A Attention Visualizations

In this appendix we display full attention patterns across distinct self-attention heads for multi-head attention layers.
